officialSyllabusSources.title: NIT Raipur IT B.Tech Semester III CBCS scheme
verifiedFacts: Search-indexed PDF identifies Branch: IT (Information Technology), B.Tech 3rd Semester.

Subject list includes IT103101IT Discrete Structures, IT103102IT Digital Electronics & Logic Design, IT103103IT Object Oriented Methodology, IT103104IT Communication Systems, IT103105IT Operating System, and IT103003MA Mathematics-III (Computational Mathematics).

learningResourceCandidates.title: NPTEL: Numerical Methods

learningResourceCandidates.title: NPTEL: Data Structures and Algorithms, IIT Delhi
learningResourceCandidates.evidence: Course outline explicitly includes stacks, queues, linked lists, hashing, trees, sorting, graphs, and graph algorithms.

learningResourceCandidates.title: NPTEL Lecture 1: Introduction to Data Structures and Algorithms
learningResourceCandidates.evidence: Search result identifies this as a verified NPTELHRD lecture by Dr. Naveen Garg, IIT Delhi, from the Data Structures and Algorithms lecture series.

learningResourceCandidates.title: NPTEL: Object Oriented Programming
learningResourceCandidates.evidence: Course outline includes classes/objects, constructors, inheritance, polymorphism, and related OOP topics.

learningResourceCandidates.title: NPTEL: Digital Circuits, IIT Kharagpur
learningResourceCandidates.evidence: Course outline includes number systems, combinational and sequential circuits, semiconductor memories, and microprocessors.

learningResourceCandidates.title: NPTEL: Graph Theory, IISER Pune
learningResourceCandidates.evidence: Course outline includes graph theory, colouring, planar graphs, and Euler's formula.

learningResourceCandidates.subjectMatch: Discrete Structures / logic, sets, relations, combinatorics
learningResourceCandidates.title: NPTEL: Discrete Mathematics, Chennai Mathematical Institute
learningResourceCandidates.evidence: Course outline includes combinatorics, graph theory, recurrence relations, and related discrete mathematics topics.

learningResourceCandidates.title: NPTEL: Computer Organization, IIT Madras
learningResourceCandidates.evidence: Course outline includes datapath/controller design, memory systems, cache, virtual memory, I/O, and buses.

learningResourceCandidates.title: NPTEL: Theory of Computation, IIT Kanpur
learningResourceCandidates.evidence: Course outline includes regular/context-free languages, decidability, undecidability, reductions, and complexity.

learningResourceCandidates.title: NPTEL: Operating System Fundamentals, IIT Kharagpur

learningResourceCandidates.evidence: Course outline explicitly includes queueing models, M/M/1, M/M/c, finite-capacity queues, and probability processes.

learningResourceCandidates.evidence: Course outline includes semiconductor diodes, BJTs, MOSFETs, op-amps, amplifiers, and regulated power supplies.
